standing: Fictional-domain technical rubric; no independent operational/user validation

raw_reader.schema: Unique JSON keys; exact schema; truncated/invalid/failed attempt incorrect
raw_reader.status: Exact match to frozen reference, no post-hoc repair
raw_reader.references: Existing IDs plus decisive fields required by documented state; status correctness judged separately
raw_reader.missing: Only genuinely unavailable fields, plus at least one critical unavailable discriminator for possible structured cards

presentation.precision: Fully correct displayed items / all displayed items; null if none
presentation.coverage: Answerable cases with at least one fully correct displayed relevant card / all answerable cases
presentation.complete_case_accuracy: Cases with exactly all relevant cards displayed correctly and no extra items / all cases, including negatives
presentation.next_check_relevance: Answerable cases with at least one correct documented check and no incorrect displayed item / all answerable cases; check ID is attached by code, not selected intelligently by model
presentation.semantic_gain: Difference in complete_case_accuracy against B1 on the pre-labelled semantic subset; include negative controls and correlated variants

severity.high: Any supported status against a non-supported reference; invented facts/causes/procedures in prose. Report raw, blocked and exposed. Conservative structured proxy, not exhaustive semantic safety detection.
severity.medium: Other wrong status, false possible orientation, missing decisive evidence or essential uncertainty, missed applicable card or invalid/failed output
severity.low: Redundant/unclear prose or omitted secondary detail without factual change

comparators.B0: Same facts plus generic request to check source records; no specific card/check, so specific task coverage is zero rather than a fluent-text success
comparators.B1: Focused BM25 candidates, same documented objective scope controls, lexical status control and literal checks
comparators.B2: Focused dense candidates and literal document presentation; report candidate retrieval as such, not validated applicability
comparators.paired_lexical: Same selected retriever as C4/C8 with lexical status control; isolates the reader contribution
comparators.C4_C8: Selected retriever plus individual-card interpretation, objective guard, immutable check text
comparators.R_star: Predeclared manually supplied development cards in calibration/triage; diagnose interpretation independent of retrieval

generation_gate.scope: Chosen validation model; gate evaluated on its complete final classification campaign before generation, without changing the frozen configuration
generation_gate.not_required_for_gate: Semantic gain/retrieval targets remain viability criteria, but the writing test independently measures added content after an acceptable selection. Do not claim overall AI viability merely because this gate passes.
generation_gate.eligible: Preselected case with at least one guard-accepted displayed card; select first such card in frozen ranking. No generation call when none, record not_eligible_selection and retain in end-to-end denominator.
generation_gate.assessment: Fact/document support per claim; no invented causes, absent-as-unknown confusion or procedures. At most two sentences/60 words. Added content must give a correct fact/document relation or verification rationale beyond the literal panel; paraphrase alone fails.
generation_gate.judging: Assistant review against frozen fictitious documents; not the tested LLM as sole judge. Conditional and end-to-end counts both required.

uncertainty: Report fractions; Wilson for binary items where appropriate; paired resampling by group for differences. Seeds/variants are not independent samples.
next_step: Final evaluator/runner may add measurement plumbing without changing frozen reader/retrieval/rubric. No reserved inference until new approval.
